title: Maternal Health Risk Prediction: Complete Research Repository
summary: A machine-learning research repository for predicting maternal health risk severity from clinical vitals, comparing a custom SMOTE-based synthetic oversampling method against deep generative baselines for handling class imbalance. It imports CTGANSynthesizer and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer from sdv.single_table (with SingleTableMetadata) to generate per-class synthetic training data as a comparison baseline that the paper reports suffers mode collapse on the small clinical table.
evidence: archive/.../src/ctgan_generator.py:64 uses CTGANSynthesizer/GaussianCopulaSynthesizer from sdv.single_table per class, trained then compared against SMOTE approach
